SOURCE: https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini/enterprise/docs/release-notes
CACHED: 2026-09-29. Entry dated 2026-09-28.
TITLE: "Configure granular access controls for apps and data stores"
- Admins can "configure granular, resource-level Identity and Access Management (IAM)
  permissions to restrict access to specific Gemini Enterprise apps and data stores using
  the Google Cloud console, the Google Cloud CLI, or the REST API."
- Gemini Enterprise Admin / Viewer / User roles can now be bound on INDIVIDUAL apps or data
  stores, without project-wide access.
- Custom PROJECT-level roles for "restricted administrators, restricted viewers, and
  restricted end users so principals can access only their assigned apps and data stores."
- New console surface: view data store configurations, connected apps, sync details and
  user permissions.
=> APP and DATA STORE are now IAM resource scopes. Project-level IAM reads no longer
   describe effective access.
